title: AI's capital-markets test: a $2 trillion debut and a chastened newcomer
summary: As Anthropic moves toward a listing that could value it above $2 trillion, its prospectus frames the boom's surging costs alongside its ambitions, and Reuters reported the filing casts an AI backlash as a risk. The market's appetite is not unconditional: Cerebras, which listed earlier this year, fell to a post-IPO low as lockups expired and Nvidia's dominance weighed. The contrast — record demand for the biggest private labs against a tougher reception for a smaller pure-play — suggests investors are pricing scale and revenue visibility, not the category. Q4 will test the window.
